text:
Sophie (CS): Heads-up: piloting a 'Lightning Lab' — 90min hands-on workshop to walk customer engineers through migrating one model from Hosted -> Dedicated. Live demo + two breakout exercises. Want to run two cohorts next week. Vote on preferred slots: Mon 10:00-11:30 PT, Wed 15:00-16:30 PT, Fri 08:00-09:30 PT. Capacity ~14 per cohort. Can volunteers for facilitation? @calendar-bot will post poll.

calendar-bot: Poll created: 'Lightning Lab cohort times' — vote here: https://cal.example/poll/3h9k (results will post in thread).

Leo R.: I can facilitate the live demo for cohort A (Mon). Happy to own infra & demo scripts.

Amir (Enablement): Can we require a short prework? 15-20m checklist so lab time is hands-on. I can draft a lightweight notebook.

Tasha (Customer Success): +1 prework. Also, please prioritize accounts with renewals in the next 90 days — I have a list of 6 that should get first dibs.

Sophie (CS): Good call. I'll add a +renewal tag to the signup form and reserve 6 seats across cohorts. Planning two cohorts: Mon & Wed; Fri will be backup if demand spikes. Recording ok?

Leo R.: Recording is fine. Let's make sure breakout rooms have one facilitator each and we enable a short live Q&A at the end. Also: quick checklist for customers to attach (model size, sample prompt).

Amir (Enablement): Put prework gist here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/lightning-prework — includes: confirm model runs locally, export tokenizer artifacts, run small sample prompt. I'll also add a one-page troubleshooting FAQ.

Tasha (Customer Success): I'll outreach to priority accounts and ask them to RSVP by EOD Tue. Can we also mark seats reserved for 'renewal priority' in the form?

Sophie (CS): :thumbsup: Yes — form will have a checkbox and note. I'll cap RSVPs at 14 per cohort and open a waitlist. Adding runbook and agenda to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/lightning-lab-agenda

calendar-bot: Poll results posted: Mon 10:00-11:30 PT (45 votes), Wed 15:00-16:30 PT (12 votes), Fri 08:00-09:30 PT (3 votes). Cohorts set: Mon & Wed. RSVP form: https://forms.gle/redwood-lightninglab

Leo R.: Volunteer facilitators: Leo R., Amir, Sophie. Need one more for breakout rooms — @Maya, any chance you can cover one?

Maya (CS Ops): I can run a breakout room and handle recording/attendance notes for both cohorts.

Sophie (CS): Awesome, thank you. Final ask: if you're covering an account, add the customer email and renewals flag in the RSVP form comments. We'll send prework + calendar invite today and a reminder 48h before the lab.

Tasha (Customer Success): On it. I'll drop the six renewal-priority emails into the form now.

Sophie (CS): Thanks team — will post the finalized agenda + facilitator rota after invites go out. Keep reactions here if anything else needed. :sparkles:
